description: Publish privacy-minimized Codex activity and explicitly opted-in public conversation messages to CAVE.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,runpy;from pathlib import Path;root=os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT');direct=Path(root,'scripts','cave_activity_hook.py') if root else None;candidates=[direct] if direct and direct.is_file() else list(Path.home().glob('.codex/plugins/cache/*/cave/*/scripts/cave_activity_hook.py'));script=max(candidates,key=lambda path:path.parents[1].name);runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name='__main__')"
